hero.title: The citation map that lives in your Zotero library.
hero.tagline: OrbLit syncs directly with Zotero, finds thematic clusters in your literature, and surfaces related papers your citations alone would never show you. Free to use, and open source.

features.title: Everything orbits the paper you're reading

search.title: Search OpenAlex
search.body: Find any paper across OpenAlex's full catalog and pull it straight onto your map.

map.title: Visualize the network
map.body: Citations and references become a network of knowledge ready to explore - drag, expand, and zoom to see how work connects.

zotero.title: Sync with Zotero
zotero.body: Connect your library once, then keep it in sync with one click - new papers, DOI matches, and additions get pulled in.

tags.title: Tag & organize
tags.body: Color-code papers by theme, track discovery vs. your collection, and never lose the thread.

map.title: Visualize the citation network
map.body: Citations and references become an interactive map — filled nodes are papers already in your collection, outlined nodes are discoveries found around it. Drag, expand, and zoom to see how the literature connects.

list.title: Every paper in one searchable list
list.body: Sort by year or citation count, filter by tag or collection scope, and jump straight back to the map to see any paper in context.

themes.title: Thematic clusters
themes.body: OrbLit embeds each paper's title and abstract and clusters them automatically — see how your reading actually groups by topic, not just by citation links.

suggestions.title: Suggested related papers
suggestions.body: Find papers that are thematically close to your collection but were never cited by or citing anything you already have — shown as squares so they're easy to tell apart from your existing collection.

zotero.title: Zotero import & sync
zotero.body: Connect your library once, build a map from any collection, and add anything you find straight back to Zotero — PDF included, no manual export/import.
